codes.label: Not collected
codes.definition: Collection was not required by the lending or underwriting criteria.

codes.label: Not loaded
codes.definition: Collected during the application but not loaded into the originator reporting system.

codes.label: Separate system
codes.definition: Collected during the application and held in a different system.

codes.label: Available later
codes.definition: Collected but available only from a specified date. The source requires ND4-YYYY-MM-DD; this catalog stores the category, not a token parser.

codes.label: Not applicable
codes.definition: The information does not apply to this field in its reporting context.

codes.label: Business
codes.definition: The submission fails one or more content validations.

codes.label: Logical
codes.definition: The submission item code is outside the permitted reporting values.

codes.label: Permission
codes.definition: The reporting entity is not allowed to submit the information.

codes.label: Schema
codes.definition: The submission does not conform to the required schema.

codes.label: Representativeness
codes.definition: The submission fails the representativeness requirement referenced by the template.
